methodology.label: Public-record valuation watch model v1
methodology.value: 45% FHFA-adjusted recorded sale + 25% locally calibrated public assessment + 30% size-matched recorded-sale comps
methodology.range: Anchor disagreement, evidence completeness and model confidence determine the displayed range
methodology.watchScore: 45% cluster edge + 25% valuation confidence + 20% assessment gap signal + 10% sale recency
methodology.boundary: The assessment gap is not acquisition edge. A true price edge requires an asking price or licensed live listing joined to the record.
